title: Lending Response
description: Container for lending state on a checkout. Tracks the lending workflow from PII collection through offer comparison.

handlers.description: Available PII handlers from the merchant UCP profile.

lenders.description: Available lenders for the selected loan type.

offers.description: Loan offers sorted by rate (ascending). Populated after application submission.

required_pii_fields.description: PII fields required for the selected loan type.

required_non_pii_fields.description: Non-PII fields required for the selected loan type (e.g. loan_amount_requested).

missing_pii_fields.description: PII fields that still need to be collected or consented.
